item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: Itsycal 0.28.0
item.description:
Menu bar calendar app

Itsycal is a compact menu bar calendar for macOS that integrates with the Calendar app so you can create and view events, join virtual meetings and see ISO week numbers. It has a clean, readable interface, an optional replacement for the system clock, dark mode, several font sizes, flexible keyboard shortcuts (including Vim-style movement and jumping to specific dates) and URL-scheme support. It is tiny and requires macOS 11 or later.

item.title: ExtendFS 1.2.2
item.description:
Mac Read Linux Disk

ExtendFS is a read-only Linux file system driver for macOS, written in Swift, and based on Apple's FSKit for ext2, ext3, and ext4 file system support. After installing and running the ExtendFS application, the user only needs to enable the file system extension in the system settings to automatically mount the corresponding volume when connecting to an external hard disk, USB flash drive or other storage device in the Linux file system format, or directly open the disk image containing the relevant file system without using command-line tools or manually performing the mount operation. The software adopts a file system extension architecture, does not require the installation of traditional kernel extensions, and does not have to modify system security settings, and can better adapt to the system security mechanism of the new version of macOS. ExtendFS is also compatible with the familiar mount command of the system, which is convenient for users with terminal operation needs to mount and manage manually. The software requires macOS 15. 6 or later for users who need to read Linux disks, access ext4 storage content, view disk images, or perform cross-platform file transfers on a Mac.

item.title: OnlySwitch release_3.5.0
item.description:
Menu Bar System Switches Collection

OnlySwitch is a powerful macOS menu bar application that provides a series of switches designed to simplify the user's daily workflow, such as hiding desktop icons, switching dark mode, and hiding the grooves of the new MacBook Pro. The user can easily control these functions in the status bar, and the displayed switches and shortcuts can be customized as needed. Since version 1. As of 7, users can import custom shortcuts into OnlySwitch and support keyboard shortcuts from version 2.0. The app also supports Apple widgets, which allow users to place relevant switches and buttons on their desktops or notification centers for quick and easy access. OnlySwitch supports switching between various macOS browsers, keeping users' browsing history and allowing users to add or remove features based on their needs. The software comes with a 30-day free trial and can be installed via Homebrew or downloaded manually. OnlySwitch is a powerful menu bar app designed to streamline users' daily workflows, such as hiding desktop icons, switching between dark modes, and hiding the bangs of the new MacBook Pro.

item.title: Switch 0.3.23
item.description:
Window-level ⌘Tab switcher for macOS

Switch is a window switcher for macOS that changes the usual ⌘-Tab behavior from app-level to window-level cycling. Use ⌘-Tab to go forward, ⇧⌘Tab to go back, and ⌥-` to cycle windows within an app, including across multiple Spaces. Windows appear in a vertical list you can filter by typing. A Sticky mode lets you preview a window without committing to the switch, and shortcuts let you close a window (⌘W), quit an app (⌘Q) or hide it (⌘H). It is free, open source, notarized, and requires macOS 14 or later.

item.title: StrokeMouse 0.0.41
item.description:
macOS Open Source Mouse Gesture Software

StrokeMouse is an open-source mouse and trackpad gesture customization tool for macOS 14 Sonoma and higher that draws free tracks by holding down the right, middle, or side keys, moves the pointer while holding down a single Fn, Control, Option, Shift, or Command modifier key to complete trackpad drawing, and experimentally supports three-to-five finger touch, double click, four-way swipe, and two-to-five finger zoom and rotation on the built-in trackpad. The software uses trajectory resampling, normalization, limited rotation, and turn structure gating to identify, match, and execute shortcuts, launch apps, open URLs, control media, manage windows, and run Shell or AppleScript. Each gesture can set a separate triggering method, target application, and scope, and can lock the foreground application, the application to which the pointer belongs, or the precise window. The gesture library provides search, filtering, sorting, batch start-stop, deletion, and JSON import and export. Duplicate configurations can be selected to skip or force import.

item.title: FluxMarkdown 1.45.774
item.description:
Markdown Quick Preview QuickLook Extension

FluxMarkdown is a Markdown quick preview tool for macOS, designed for Finder's QuickLook scene, which allows you to view the content of a document instantly by pressing a space, without having to open the editor first. It can not only render common Markdown, but also supports Mermaid charts, KaTeX mathematical formulas, GitHub Flavored Markdown, directory panels, code highlighting, and a variety of chart syntaxes. It is suitable for programmers, technical writers, and document organizers to quickly confirm the layout and content structure when browsing files. The software also provides PDF and HTML export, scaling and panning, scrolling position memory, light and dark color, and system theme switching, and can adjust the rendering and editing experience through the settings window, and has high compatibility with a variety of Markdown-related extensions.

item.title: MiaoYan 4.8.0
item.description:
macOS Native Markdown Editor

MiaoYan is a lightweight Markdown laptop app designed to help users easily write beautiful sentences. It features purely local use for security while supporting features such as syntax highlighting, dark mode, and automatic document layout. Users can enjoy a minimalistic three-column design that includes folders, file lists, and an editor for a great visual experience. MiaoYan uses Swift5 for native development, outperforms traditional web applications, and provides a number of shortcuts to improve editing efficiency. Other features include document export, internal jumps, graph bed support, and support for LaTeX, Mermaid, PlantUML, and Markmap brainstorming, making it a versatile writing tool.

item.title: magpie 0.1.3250
item.description:
AI Programming Agent Model Switching

magpie is an open source model routing tool for AI programming agents that runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux and unifies different agents and model services through a native gateway. After adding providers such as DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, Qwen, Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama, etc., you can select the corresponding model among the agents such as Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, etc., without duplicating the key configuration for each agent. magpie can convert interface formats such as OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini, and retain streaming response, tool call, and inference capabilities; it also supports connecting logged-in subscriptions such as Claude, ChatGPT, and GitHub Copilot to other agents. Users can set up intelligent model routing for different tasks, assign requests according to their intent, or automatically switch accounts according to account quota, reset time, rate limit, and fault conditions to reduce request interruptions.

item.title: Reflow 26.7.1
item.description:
Multi Instrument Sheet Music Editor

Reflow is a powerful score and fingerprint editor designed for guitar, bass, drum, piano and many other musical instruments. It has been trusted by thousands of musicians around the world for more than ten consecutive years. It provides an intuitive visual keyboard input interface to support the fingerprint editing of string instruments (such as guitar, bass, banjo, ukulele) (including chord diagrams, bends, brushstrings and other effects), standard pentagram notation (including large spectral tables, cross-spectral wiring and other advanced functions). ), professional drum chromatography (supports tremolo, flam, drag, etc.), built-in high-quality Apple native rendering engine and synthesizer for instant playback, monorail/mute, loop segment, shifting exercise, real-time editing, core functions are completely free and watermark-free, subscribe to the premium version to permanently unlock watermark-free PDF export, 128 GM tones, multi-track music score display, metronome, playback speed control, MIDI keyboard input, etc., all data Local storage and support iCloud synchronization, no networking, no tracking, no account, compatible with Guitar Pro file reading and writing, MusicXML import, PDF export printing and cross-platform sharing (iPhone, iPad, Mac are available), carefully built by independent developers since 2011, dedicated to sound...

item.title: Eye Monitor 13.1.21
item.description:
Smart break reminder tool

Eye Monitor – Break Reminders, an iOS app that works with macOS apps, has gained traction on platforms like Hacker News, Product Hunt, and sspai.com, and ranks # 1 in health and fitness apps in 13 countries. The app alerts users when their Mac's fatigue reaches a preset threshold and prevents them from indulging in the phone while away from the computer. Its macOS version is a fully automated fatigue monitoring and alerting tool designed to help users rest, relax, and reduce fatigue. Eye Monitor automatically analyzes the user's behavior, such as mouse, trackpad, scroll wheel movement, and keyboard input, to notify the user that the fatigue threshold has been reached. The app can be used as a rest reminder, hydration reminder, stretch reminder, screen time reminder, RSI reminder, etc. to help users maintain eye health and improve sitting-related issues. Eye Monitor is an app designed to help users reduce visual fatigue and stay healthy, and works with macOS versions.

item.title: PeakHour 6.2.3
item.description:
macOS Menu Bar Network Traffic Monitor

PeakHour: Internet Monitor is a real-time network monitoring tool for macOS that centralizes bandwidth, latency, wireless signals, and connection health to troubleshoot video conferencing issues, slow downloads, network outages, and poor broadband performance. The software displays Mac, router, and carrier-to-Internet connectivity paths through menu bars and visual dashboards, helps determine where performance bottlenecks lie, and enables monitoring of UPnP or SNMP-capable routers, switches, and NAS. Built-in speed measurement combines download speed, upload speed, and rpm responsiveness ratings, and you can also see actual performance against your broadband plan. Wi-Fi analytics identifies weak signals and distractions, while historical charts make it easy to look back at traffic, delays, congestion, and disconnections. Apple Intelligence-based network consultants can rate connections, explain questions and advise in plain English, and require a Mac that supports that capability.

item.title: SwiftServer 2.2.3
item.description:
Server/Docker Monitoring Management Tool

SwiftServer is a powerful iOS and macOS app designed to help system administrators, developers, and IT professionals monitor and manage servers anytime, anywhere. It provides real-time CPU, memory, storage, networking, and Docker performance monitoring, all easily accessible through an intuitive dashboard. Users can easily add and organize servers, use SFTP for file management, upload, download, and edit, and securely sync across devices via iCloud. The main functions of SwiftServer include real-time monitoring, comprehensive resource management, code fragment execution, customized terminals, and cross-device synchronization. User feedback shows that the app excels in server management and resource monitoring, especially for professionals who need remote access and real-time data. SwiftServer is a powerful server monitoring and management tool designed for system administrators, developers, and IT professionals. It provides real-time server performance monitoring, file management, and a full-featured terminal, ensuring users have control over their servers anytime, anywhere.

item.title: NookX 2026.11.07
item.description:
Smart Island Dynamic Interactive Tool

Designed for macOS, Nook X is an efficient interactive tool that emulates Liu Haiping and offers a variety of personalized features such as date, time, weather temperature display, quick launch, and to-do widgets. With Nook X, users can turn the Liuhai area into an information center, greatly improving the utilization of screen space. The tool offers a wealth of customization options that allow users to tailor the display and style to their individual needs, enhancing productivity while blending seamlessly with desktop style. Personalized display: Nook X can display information such as date, time, weather temperature, etc. Users can customize the display content according to their needs and create a personalized dashboard. Quick launch: Users can quickly launch common applications through Nook X for convenient and efficient work. To-do widget: integrate to-do function to help users manage daily tasks and improve work efficiency. Temporary Notes feature: allows users to quickly take temporary notes, making it easy to capture inspiration or important information at any time.

item.title: AnySearch Pro 3.5.1
item.description:
File search tool for macOS

AnySearch Pro is a fast file search and disk content analysis tool for macOS that uses smart indexing and full-text search to find files among hundreds of thousands. A global hotkey opens a floating search panel from any app, and you can search by contains, prefix, suffix, exact match or wildcard. It supports combined filters (extension, type, size, modified date, folder scope, disk source) and searches the text of PDF, Markdown, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, highlighting matches in snippets. Results support quick preview, opening, revealing in Finder, and copying names or paths. Real-time file system monitoring keeps the index current, including iCloud Drive and external USB and Thunderbolt disks.

item.title: OnDevice OCR Pro 3.4.2
item.description:
Batch OCR tool for documents on macOS

OnDevice OCR Pro is an offline OCR and batch document processing tool for Mac that turns scans, images and PDFs into full-text searchable content. It runs entirely on your Mac with no cloud or subscription, so sensitive files stay local, which suits legal, medical, financial and office use. It can watch folders and process new documents automatically, with batch recognition, auto-rotation, image enhancement and smart skipping of already digital PDFs. Built-in multilingual OCR covers Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German and more, and it can extract text only to save disk space. It is well suited to invoices, receipts, contracts and research material.

item.title: Netutilus 1.21.1
item.description:
macOS Web Toolkit

Netutilus: Network Utility is a professional network diagnostic tool designed for Mac that integrates 8 classic and powerful network utilities to help users easily troubleshoot network problems, monitor connection status, and perform advanced diagnostics. Netutilus retains all the benefits of the traditional macOS networking tools that users love, while being fully upgraded with a modern interface design and added power. It provides TCP-based ping testing with real-time latency charts and detailed statistics; supports Traceroute and visual Traceroute (Gold Tier) to track packet paths by hop or view routing information on an interactive world map; built-in speed testing to measure downloads, uplinks, latency and jitter using Cloudflare's global network; DNS query supports custom DNS servers, querying A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, SOA, PTR and other record types;

item.title: Ember 1.6.6
item.description:
Private life diary software

Ember: Journal & Life Archive is a private logging tool that combines diary and interpersonal memory archives for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. When writing down daily, just mention a person in the text, and the relevant content will be gathered on the other person's personal page, gradually presenting the common experience, the time of acquaintance and the context of contact; You can also organize people by circles, such as home, work or campus, and use stories to record chapters of life that span many years. Dynamic retrospectives reimagine old memories on the right dates and gently remind you to keep an eye out for people you haven't been in touch with for a long time. The software provides calendars, maps, and people maps to help you navigate through life's snippets from dates, places, and networks, as well as support for searching text throughout your archives and photos. You can add photos, videos, voice memos, Apple Music songs, and weather, and import Day One, Apple Journal, and contacts. The diary is saved on the device and can be locked with Face ID, Touch ID or password and synced privately via personal iCloud;

item.title: LitPads SoundBoard 1.9.8
item.description:
Mac Live Audio Routing Tool

LitPads is a custom soundboard app for musicians, DJs, podcasters, live streamers, theater and live event voice controls, and content creators that creates multiple soundboards on Mac, iPhone, and iPad, imports your own audio files, and triggers playback with ultra-low latency. It supports one-time triggering, looping, switching, press-and-hold playback and other modes. Each Pad can independently adjust the volume, audio, fade, EQ, tone change, clip range and reverb, and provide multi-voice playback. It is suitable for live performances, program crossovers, stage prompts, church and theater cue, TikTok/Reels material production, and live workflows such as OBS, Twitch, YouTube Live, Discord, and Zoom. The Mac side can be used with virtual audio drivers for audio routing. Functions such as MIDI control, track serialization, automatic depression, global fade-out, cue list, and iCloud synchronization make complex performance processes easier to manage.

item.title: StreamVox 1.6.3
item.description:
macOS Real-Time AI Speech Translation

StreamVox is an AI real-time speech translation and subtitling tool for macOS that captures system sounds, microphone inputs, or audio from specific apps to generate real-time, low-latency subtitles for online meetings, video sessions, live streams, games, video content, and face-to-face conversations. It supports 52 input languages and 60 translation languages, and provides six modes: universal, game, conference, live video, high-precision, and medical. It can optimize the recognition effect of terminology, tone, person name, number, drug name, and unit of measurement according to the scene. The two-way dialogue mode automatically determines the speaker and language, displaying the content of both sides in different colors, suitable for cross-language meetings, interviews, reception and customer support. Sticky subtitle windows always stick to the top and lock the position, support paragraph or line-by-line reading, and can also call macOS system voice to read the translation naturally. By app capture, you can only listen to specified programs such as Zoom, Teams, Safari, FaceTime, etc. to reduce other sound interference.

item.title: WaterKit 1.1.3
item.description:
Menu bar to view today's water in real time

WaterKit is a drinking water logging and rehydration reminder tool for macOS, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch that helps users establish stable drinking habits through intuitive progress, dynamic characters, and achievement challenges. The software offers 45 drink types to record water, tea, coffee, juice, milk, sports drinks, and soups, and allows you to adjust the order of drinks, customize icon colors, set your favorite cups, and switch between milliliters, ounces, and liters. The system will combine weight, gender, and activity data to recommend daily goals, with 80 notification texts, 5 types of reminder tones, 19 sounds, and time-sharing scenarios to provide more natural prompts at different times. Users can view drinking water and caffeine statistics from the daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly dimensions, and understand long-term performance through monthly heat maps, recent seven-day insights, and percentage habit scores. The software supports Apple health data reading and writing, iCloud real-time synchronization, Siri voice recording, real-time activities, lock screen and desktop widgets, and the Mac menu bar water droplets will also change dynamically with the intake of the day.

item.title: MindSpace 1.10.29
item.description:
Lightweight, concise mind mapping tool

MindSpace is an app designed to quickly create concise mind maps that users can edit on their Mac, iPad, and iPhone and export images or PDFs at any time to share while learning and working. The software allows users to quickly adjust the information structure, distinguish ideas by different colors and formats, insert stickers to make the information more vivid, and provide a rich theme style to help users build a fortress of knowledge. MindSpace also enables the quick capture of inspiration, turning instant ideas into a piece of knowledge with a minimalistic look that puts information at the heart and reduces distractions. At the same time, MindSpace ensures data security and full ownership of the user's data. Users can easily share intuitive mind maps to improve team efficiency. The app adopts a subscription model, users can choose monthly or annual subscriptions, and need to cancel the auto-renewal 24 hours before the end of the subscription, the current subscription fee is not refundable, all terms of service and precautions please read carefully.

item.title: PastePaw 2.8.0
item.description:
Mac Clipboard Enhancer

PastePaw is a privacy-first clipboard history management tool for macOS that automatically saves copied text, images, files, and folders, and records source apps to keep things neat with smart deduplication, history limits, and regular cleanup. The software offers two layouts, horizontal cards and vertical bars attached to the edges of the screen, with 29 built-in themes that can be fixed or dragged to fit different ways of working. Press the space to preview the clipboard content. Markdown and code support full GitHub style rendering and syntax highlighting. Images can be OCR, real-time text recognition, QR and barcode scanning, and subject extraction. Text also supports formatting, encoding conversion, hash generation, and QR code generation. Users can organize content with collections, smart collections, and encrypted collections that support Touch ID, and access it quickly with full-text search, drag-and-drop, multi-select, and bulk paste. Global shortcuts, auto-paste, and keyboard navigation make it quick to call from any app.

item.title: Taphouse 1.5.9.2
item.description:
Graphical Homebrew package management tool

Taphouse is a Homebrew graphical user interface tool for Mac designed to manage Homebrew packages in a visual way, making it easy for users to operate without having to go through a terminal. It provides a wealth of features, including one-click installation and uninstallation programs, automatic detection of updates, service management, security detection, etc., to help users efficiently maintain and manage software packages. Taphouse supports a variety of features, such as importing external applications into Homebrew, monitoring disk usage in real time, automatic background updates, and quick access to the menu bar, allowing users to visually browse and manage their installed programs. Taphouse has a simple and transparent pricing model that offers both free and professional versions, allowing users to purchase licenses on demand. With Taphouse, users can enjoy a simple package management experience without relying on the command line, suitable for all levels of users. Taphouse is a powerful macOS app designed for Homebrew users with a graphical package management interface that makes it easy to manage Homebrew packages without using a terminal.

item.title: extraDock 5.2.5-beta.3
item.description:
macOS Create Multiple Dock Tools

ExtraDock is a lightweight app designed for macOS users that improves productivity by creating multiple floating docks. It supports macOS 12 and above, and users can customize multiple docks as needed, each of which can set up separate apps, folders, layouts, and behaviors. The software allows the Dock to float freely or be fixed to the edge of the screen, and also supports automatic hiding or storing as needed, saving screen space. ExtraDock also has a full-screen app-aware feature that automatically hides in full-screen mode and recovers location when connected. At the same time, it offers multiple color themes and adjustable dock sizes, allowing users to make arbitrary layouts based on their individual workflows. Users can easily add apps and folders by dragging and dropping. ExtraDock's performance is optimized to ensure low CPU and memory usage and provide a smooth animation experience. ExtraDock is a lightweight application that allows you to create multiple floating Docks on macOS.

item.title: Widgetscape 1.4.5
item.description:
macOS Native Desktop Widget

Widgetscape is a native desktop widget tool for macOS that provides 31 widgets covering time, efficiency, system monitoring, and life information to bring schedules, weather, music playback, hardware status, and development activities directly to the desktop. The software adopts a unified grid layout and supports eight sizes. Each size has an independently designed content layout. It automatically absorbs and aligns when dragging, and can also be placed freely. The user can adjust the appearance through 23 sets of color schemes, light and dark modes, and four surface styles: glass, solid color, stroke, and transparent, and set the position for different monitors and desktop spaces. Featured features include a Day Timeline that displays the schedule along the edge of the screen, Token Pulse that reads the logs of local AI programming tools, and Repo Pulse that looks at Git branches and changes. The Playing component supports media information and playback controls for Music, Spotify, Safari, and Chrome. The software is developed using Swift, does not rely on web view, redraws only when the content changes, and the invisible components stop working.

item.title: ByteMail 1.9.21
item.description:
AI-enhanced native Mac email client

bytemail is a native Mac email client built with SwiftUI and AppKit, with no bundled browser engine. It supports Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Microsoft 365, Yahoo, Fastmail and other IMAP accounts in one fast unified inbox. Features include conversation and classic views, instant cross-account and attachment search, smart labels, rule-based archiving, snooze, scheduled send, undo send, reminders and per-account signatures. It connects directly to your mail provider, keeps credentials in the macOS Keychain, and sends no mail, contacts or usage data through bytemail servers. Tracking pixels and tracking link parameters are stripped, and it flags spoofed domains and suspicious links. It also offers local summaries, smart replies and Rewrite, and connects to AI apps such as Claude, Codex and Cursor through MCP.

item.title: Backdrop 2.10.6
item.description:
Powerful 4K live wallpaper engine for macOS

Backdrop is a live wallpaper and video desktop tool for macOS that turns your desktop and lock screen into smooth visual scenes. It supports 4K video wallpapers, browsing community creations, importing your own videos, multi-display playback and playlists. You can filter community wallpapers by style, color, mood, resolution or creator, or quickly make your own background from a video. It is optimized for Mac with hardware acceleration, plays smoothly on Retina and multi-screen setups, and lowers resource use when apps are full screen or the Mac is on battery. Its lock screen video wallpaper support keeps the desktop and lock screen visually consistent.

item.title: SpaceJump 3.0.3
item.description:
macOS Multi-Desk Space Manager

SpaceJump is a productivity tool created for the macOS Spaces desktop space to solve the problem that the system can only display "Desktop 1, Desktop 2, Desktop 3" for a long time and it is difficult to identify the workspace. It allows users to set names, icons, and colors for each Space, and display these custom names in the menu bar, Mission Control, and Quick Switcher, so that work, writing, music, code, design, research, and other scenarios can be clearly partitioned. Users can call up Quick Switcher through shortcuts, enter keywords to quickly jump to the target space after filtering, or return to the previous position with one click. The software also supports dragging windows to different spaces, adding notes and lists to spaces, setting independent hotkeys, configuring click automation, and providing session time tracking, idle detection, and CSV export by space and application statistics. Developed in native Swift, it is lightweight and suitable for multi-monitor users, developers, designers, freelancers, students, and remote workers managing complex desktop workflows.

item.title: Notchy 2.0.5
item.description:
macOS bangs augmentation tool

Notchy is a native macOS agile island and efficiency tool that turns the bangs area of the screen into an interactive control center that can run as a suspended capsule on Macs and external monitors without bangs. The software integrates music playback, synchronized lyrics, clipboard history, file staging, pomodoro timing, window snapping, and system status prompts to focus common actions at the top of the screen, reducing the number of switching windows and lookup menus. For development scenarios, it can track the usage, quota window and expenses of Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and other tools, and display the execution status of agent activities, permission requests and long-time commands. Face unlocking is achieved through camera, Apple Vision local recognition and live detection. Facial features and passwords are saved in the macOS keychain, which is a convenient unlocking function, not equivalent to the infrared depth recognition of Apple Face ID. Notchy also provides app-independent volume, AirPods battery, OCR image text search, meeting suggestions, calendar reminders, and shortcut entries to support custom panels, gestures, and multiple real-time events displayed side-by-side.

item.title: Awesome Copy 8.1b2
item.description:
macOS Clipboard Manager

Awesome Copy is a powerful clipboard history manager designed for Apple users to improve speed, design, and privacy. It tracks everything a user copies, including text, images, links, files, and music, allowing users to quickly access, reuse, and organize clipboard content at any time. The app brings together useful features like dynamic island-inspired file previews, the iOS companion app, and comprehensive two-way sync to ensure a secure and seamless docking of clipboard history between Mac, iPhone, and iPad. In terms of privacy, AwesomeCopy uses local storage and iCloud encryption, never tracking the use of data or sharing clipboard content to ensure that users' privacy is protected. Customize your workspace with 16 beautiful themes and enjoy Siri shortcut integration, rich text support, and advanced features like text-to-speech, auto-paste, and customizable global hotkeys. AwesomeCopy is a full-featured clipboard history manager built for Apple users who value speed, design, and privacy.

item.title: EdgeBar 1.12.1
item.description:
macOS Trackpad Edge Controls Brightness Volume

EdgeBar is a menu bar tool for macOS that turns the edges of your MacBook trackpad into volume, screen brightness, and media playback controls. By default, the volume is adjusted by swiping along the right edge, the brightness is adjusted by swiping along the left edge, and the system prompts that are consistent with the keyboard adjustment are displayed; the left and right functions can be swapped as usual. Double-click the top right corner to quickly mute, the bottom media bar supports swiping to cut songs and double-click to play or pause, and you can reverse the direction of the cut song gesture. Provides slight tactile feedback when swiping, supports quarter step adjustment while holding down Shift and Option, and enables fine swiping without the need for a key. The software allows you to adjust the width of the edge, limit the sliding start area to three-quarters, one-half, or one-quarter below the edge, and configure the modifier key requirements to freeze with the cursor to reduce false touches in daily operations. The menu bar panel displays brightness and volume in real time, provides tactile intensity, light and dark appearance, login activation and automatic update settings, and optionally supports Magic Mouse top edge sliding.

item.title: Keylume 2.3.6
item.description:
macOS Demo Keyboard Tool

Keylume is a stylish on-screen keyboard tool designed for macOS for screen recording and live demo scenes. Keylume provides a complete view of the Apple keyboard, including media keys, arrow keys, and all modifier keys, perfectly matching the look and layout of a real Apple keyboard, many other key visualization tools only show modifier key combinations or omit function keys, while Keylume shows the entire keyboard. Keylume has a variety of beautiful themes built in and an intuitive theme editor that makes it easy for users to create personalized styles, save themes, share them with others, or import themes made by others. Keylume automatically pops up at the start of screen recording and automatically hides after the recording stops, detecting the response in just one second, and also supports manually switching the display by tapping the fn key three times. Keylume supports hovering and tapping fn to enable auto-hiding mode, let the keyboard fade out and allow click penetration, and can freely drag and drag reposition and resize, position information will be automatically remembered. Users can set up app ignore lists to avoid repeated triggering of keyboard displays by background silent recording apps such as backup tools or picture-in-picture utilities.
